# Instruction Index

Use the most specific file that matches the task.

When a new feature rule, alias, or workflow appears, add it to the matching task-specific file and keep this index updated.

- [general.instructions.md](general.instructions.md) — repo-wide work style, file responsibilities, validation, and safety rules.
- [git.instructions.md](git.instructions.md) — commit, push, PR, and git workflow rules.
- [testing.instructions.md](testing.instructions.md) — test commands, migration workflow, and seed guidance.
- [task-specifics/scan-to-task.instructions.md](task-specifics/scan-to-task.instructions.md) — scan-to-task feature behavior, state semantics, and naming.

When a task spans multiple areas, follow the more specific instruction file first, then the general file.
